description: Draft a Google post (up to 1500 characters) with a button, optionally a photo, optionally an offer with dates and a code, and optionally a time to publish in the future. Base it on something true about the business — a service, a real review, holiday hours — never an invented promotion. Creates a DRAFT only — nothing on Google changes. Show the owner the draft this returns, word for word, and publish it with publish_change only after they say yes.

button.description: Default LEARN_MORE with a url, otherwise CALL.

button_url.description: https link for every button except CALL.

photo_url.description: Public https image link. The listing's own photo links from my_photos work.

publish_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time to publish later (10 minutes to 90 days out). Omit to publish on approval.

name: propose_post
title: Draft a Google post, now or scheduled
